title: Vercel CI no longer requires a linked Vercel project
summary_en: Vercel CI can now run on a GitHub repository that has no Vercel project. Until now you had to create an empty project just to connect the repository. To enable it, you need: The Vercel GitHub App installed with access to the repository Your GitHub account connected to your Vercel account Write or admin permission on the repository Then, from a clone of the repository, run: CI is enabled for the team your CLI is set to. Pass --scope <team> to use a different one. From the next push, tasks run as configured in your repository. Private GitHub repositories only. Public repositories and other Git…
